title: Belief in Allah’s angels
intro: “Wa mala’ikatihi” – I believe in Allah’s angels, who are with us by night and by day.

learn.text: For each one are successive [angels] before and behind him who protect him by the decree of Allah.

learn.html: The existence of Allah’s angels is confirmed by the Qur’an and the hadith. Allah created the angels in a beautiful form, able to appear in human shape – as the angel Jibril appeared to Muhammad (SAW) and to Maryam. Jibril brought the whole Qur’an from Allah to the Prophet (SAW) over the 23 years of his mission.

Angels are unseen, spiritual beings with understanding, created from nur (light). They do not eat, drink or sleep, they are neither male nor female, and they never sin. They always praise and serve Allah (SWT), and that makes them happy. There are very many angels – only Allah knows how many. We know about them only what is revealed in the Qur’an or said in the hadith.

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) said: “Angels take turns with you by night and by day.” <small>(Bukhari and Muslim)</small>

learn.text: The best-known angels and their duties

items: Jibril – brought Allah’s revelation to His messengers. The Qur’an also calls him Ar-Ruh al-Amin (the Trustworthy Spirit) and Ruh al-Qudus (the Holy Spirit).
Azra’il (Malak al-Mawt) – the angel of death, who takes the soul from the body at the moment of death.
Mika’il – in charge of nature: the moving of the clouds and the falling of rain, droughts, winds, tornadoes and typhoons, the growing of plants and fruit.
Israfil – will announce the end of the world by blowing the trumpet (sur). The first blow will be the end of this world; the second, the bringing back to life and the start of the Day of Judgement.
Kiraman Katibin – the honourable scribes, who stay with people, write down their deeds and bring them good thoughts.
Munkar and Nakir – question every person in the grave.

learn.html: The Qur’an also mentions the angels Harut and Marut and the Zabaniyah. Because of their duties, the bond between angels and people is strong: angels guard us in our mother’s womb, look after us in this world, write down our deeds, encourage us to do good, and take the soul at the moment of death.

learn.text: Some benefits of believing in the angels

items: It protects us from sin, because the angels write down our good and bad deeds.
We love them, because they always worship Allah and always obey Him.

Believers feel safe and calm, because Allah has given angels the duty to make du‘a for the believers and ask Allah to forgive them – and angels guard every person, and even help believers in hard times.
